# Web SDK Setup Guide (JavaScript)

Source: https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-web

The Linkzly Web SDK adds Linkzly to a website or a web app. It records each browser's first visit and its sessions, sends custom events and purchases, keeps the smart link and UTM attribution a visitor arrived with, and can track page views, time on page, scroll depth and clicks on links to other sites.

The package is `@linkzly/web-sdk`. It has no dependencies, ships with TypeScript types, and works with any framework or none. It runs in the browser only.

> **Note:** This page is for websites and web apps. To send Gaming Intelligence events from a web game, see [Web Games (JavaScript)](https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-web-javascript), which uses a different endpoint and different credentials.
